wal_policy.qualification: measure rollback and WAL on the same workload and hardware
wal_policy.decision: do not enable WAL unless concurrency/update benefit exceeds checkpoint, sidecar, and atomicity costs

supported: local filesystem with reliable POSIX/ APFS locking and rename semantics
filesystem.enforcement: The storage layer does not guess filesystem type; deployment preflight must reject paths outside the supported local-filesystem contract before publishing a database as current.

busy_timeout.why: bounded retry for a concurrent reader/writer

journal_mode.why: rollback journal keeps one-file publication and avoids unqualified WAL sidecars

temp_store.why: do not trade bounded disk behavior for unmeasured RSS

page_size.why: changing it requires a controlled rebuild

foreign_keys.why: validate reads against the core contract

busy_timeout.why: bounded retry while a writer publishes

journal_mode.why: never mutate the file or create WAL sidecars on open

synchronous.why: read-only open must not change durability state

cache_size.why: reader-specific tuning is outside the core contract

profiles.policy: schema migration completes before current-state publication; failed work remains rollback-recoverable or stale-but-valid
PRAGMA optimize is safe to run routinely; ANALYZE is explicit and measured because it mutates statistics

nullable_identity.entity_edge: retain the existing COALESCE unique index until normalized sentinel storage is measured; HSE-77 owns identity normalization
nullable_identity.expression_index_policy: do not add another expression index for a predicate-only optimization

maintenance.analyze: explicit Storage::refresh_statistics only after measured transform/reindex boundaries
maintenance.vacuum: manual maintenance only; auto_vacuum remains database-defined until benchmark evidence justifies rebuild cost
maintenance.checkpoint: WAL-only qualification step; rollback profile has no WAL checkpoint sidecar

identity_and_recovery.current_state: only integrity-valid, schema-compatible, identity-matching databases are current; interrupted work is stale-but-valid until revalidated
